derivation.boundary: Every official path beginning with /v1/identity/; no Stripe Identity path is omitted.
normalizations: Selected the complete Stripe Identity path prefix from the pinned official monolithic contract.
Retained the transitive closure of every non-error Schema referenced by those paths.

Projected the shared Stripe error envelope to six Identity-relevant public fields and kept additionalProperties=true, avoiding unrelated payments and billing Schema expansion without rejecting provider additions.

Renamed the two upstream component identifiers containing dots to TypeScript-safe internal component identifiers and rewrote only their local references; wire field names, paths, media types, and payload shapes are unchanged.

Lower-camel-cased the eight upstream operationId values for the flat TypeScript client and retained each exact source value in x-pontx-upstream-operation-id; HTTP methods, paths, parameters, and payloads are unchanged.
Removed the four upstream GET requestBody declarations after asserting that each was an empty closed object; all meaningful GET inputs remain query/path parameters and no request field was removed.

Promoted the optional inline related_person request object to a local component reference so TypeScript keeps the property optional while still requiring account and person whenever the object is supplied.
Converted relative Stripe documentation links to absolute docs.stripe.com links.
Added safe request examples, immutable evidence, and a proxy-disabled reason to all eight Endpoints.
Translated 131 unique official summaries and descriptions while preserving every wire identifier, constraint, enum, example, media type, security declaration, and array order.
derivation.method: one-time @pontx/spec importOpenAPI conversion; PontxSpec is canonical after migration

sensitiveData: single-use client secrets and redirect URLs
riskReview.credentialPolicy: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY remains in the caller environment and is never persisted or included in examples.
riskReview.dataPolicy: Hub serves documentation only and does not proxy, cache, log, or persist Stripe Identity requests or responses.
